scope: Guarded repository/controller reviewed-resolution save and read-only archive inspection; UI remains disabled
functionality: Explicit confirmation is required before a reviewed save starts; missing intent changes neither storage nor save status.
Repository copies the reviewed snapshot and original draft before asynchronous work; existing vault atomically writes original draft archive and reviewed customer snapshot.
Stale review or storage failure sets needs-inspection; no automatic retry, merge or discard.
Archive inspection requires an unlocked current session and revokes late plaintext on lock.
Controller guards verified identity before and after resolution operations.
